Name: (AT) Anthropologie Holiday Collection by Sailor Vesta
Author: SailorVesta
Description:
[b][size=4]﻿DESCRIPTION

[/size][/b][size=3]Custom AT Content Pack based on some of my favorite Anthropologie holiday décor. This was a  passion project, I hope you all like it :)  
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]There are two color themes, bright and classic. Most items have sprites in each theme. Take a look at the furniture preview to see the different textures[/size][size=3]The following items are retextured:
[/size][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]Oceanic Rug[/b]: Joy Rug; Sled Rug; Wreathe Rug; Gingerbread House Rug[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Brick Fireplace[/b]: Classic & Colorful Mantle[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Lg. Futan Bear[/b]: Classic &  Colorful Present Stack[/size]
[*][size=3][b]House Plant[/b]: Classic Nutcrackers (2) & Colorful Nutcrackers (2)[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Jade Hills Extended[/b]: Classic & Colorful Stocking Display; Whimsical Wreathe Display[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Sun #45:[/b] Classic & Colorful Wreathe[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Topiary Tree[/b]: Classic &  Colorful Micro-Tree[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Tree of Winter Star[/b]: Classic &  Colorful Ornament Tree; Classic & Colorful Bow Tree[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]I originally planned for extra items but I'm not happy with the sprites at this point and I wanted to get this out before the holiday. I will add the items if I can get the sprites right:
[/size][size=3]
[list]
[*][size=3]Iridescent Glass Menorah[/size]
[*][size=3]Colorful Ornament Wreathe[/size]
[*][size=3]String lights[/size]
[*][size=3]Garlands[/size]
[*][size=3]Large Boho Rugs[/size]
[/list][/size][b][size=4]COMPATIBILITY

[/size][/b][size=3]This is an AT Pack so it should be compatible with everything. 


[/size][b][size=4]FAQ[/size][/b][list]
[*][b][size=4]Will you make a CP Version? [/size][/b]
[*][size=4]Possibly. I've only ever made AT Packs for personal use before, if this is a popular request I'll work on it.[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][b][size=4]Can I use this mod for INSERT USE?[/size][/b]
[*][size=4]Please don’t use my textures or mods before getting my consent. This includes recolors outside of personal use.[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4][b]Okay, so will you make INSERT recolor then? [/b] Potentially, but I'm going to be honest I'm not into neutrals or the desaturated look. I don't see myself taking time to work on those. [/size]
[/list]

[b][size=4]More Nonsense[/size][/b]

Last but not least, I'm new at this. Any constructive feedback on my sprites is greatly appreciated. 

[size=4]Sailor Vesta Mods are made In loving memory of Robin Joy & Rose.
I love and miss you both immeasurably. Always. [/size]
